breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the dynamic amplification from a suddenly applied load; for a linear elastic bar, the peak stress is not the same as the static stress.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly stated that the peak stress from a suddenly applied load is the same as the static stress (P/A). The generated specification correctly identifies the dynamic amplification effect, stating that the maximum stress is twice the static stress (2 * P/A). This resolves the inconsistency by replacing the incorrect physical assumption with the correct one.
